note: Console commands for the Console Helper. 'command' is a template; {name} placeholders are filled from 'params'. Descriptions are written for this app, not copied from the wiki.

commands.title: Auto-Attack + Crouch
commands.description: Fires continuously on full-auto weapons and crouches at the same time, without holding your mouse button or Ctrl.

commands.title: Auto-Run
commands.description: Move forward and sprint continuously without holding W or Shift. Tap the key again to stop.

commands.title: Toggle Crouch
commands.description: Stays crouched until you press the key again, instead of holding Ctrl down.

commands.title: Lower Master Volume (Toggle)
commands.description: Temporarily ducks the game's own volume without touching Windows or Discord. Built for exactly the moment a jackhammer or chainsaw is drowning out voice comms. Tap again to restore full volume.

commands.title: Instant Craft
commands.description: Crafts the chosen item straight from a key, skipping the crafting menu. Defaults to a single bandage.

commands.title: Cancel Craft
commands.description: Removes queued crafts of the chosen item from your crafting queue.

commands.title: Quick FOV Zoom
commands.description: Punches the field of view in for better target identification at range, then snaps back when you tap again.

commands.title: Field of View
commands.description: Sets the field of view once. 90 is the maximum the game accepts.

commands.title: Disable Gibs
commands.description: Turns off the debris objects that spawn when a wall, vehicle or player is destroyed. Fewer objects during a raid means a steadier frame rate.

commands.title: Precise Look-At Radius
commands.description: Tightens the invisible interaction cone, so you don't accidentally grab, open or loot the wrong item when several are packed close together. 0.2 is the game default.

commands.title: Disable Head-Look Inertia
commands.description: Makes your view snap straight back to centre the instant you release alt-look, instead of drifting back with momentum.

commands.title: Hit Marker Detail
commands.description: Controls how much detail hit notifications carry. Higher values show more information about registered hits.

commands.title: Lower Sensitivity While Aiming
commands.description: Drops mouse sensitivity the moment you aim down sights and restores it when you let go. Bind this to your aim button.

commands.title: Light On While Aiming
commands.description: Switches your weapon light or laser on while you aim down sights.

commands.title: Mouse Sensitivity
commands.description: Sets mouse sensitivity directly, finer than the settings slider allows.

commands.title: Combat Log On Console Open
commands.description: Opens the console and prints your recent combat log in one keystroke, so you can check what actually hit you.

commands.title: Combat Log
commands.description: Prints your recent hits taken and dealt, with weapon, distance and damage.

commands.title: Say In Global Chat
commands.description: Sends a fixed message to global chat from a key.

commands.title: Say In Team Chat
commands.description: Sends a fixed message to team chat from a key. Handy for a quick "on my way" during a fight.

commands.title: Disconnect
commands.description: Leaves the server immediately. Bound to a key it is faster than the menu, which matters when you are combat-logging out of a bad spot.

commands.title: Suicide
commands.description: Kills your character. Useful when you are stuck in terrain and would rather respawn than wait.

commands.title: Force Garbage Collection
commands.description: Frees memory the game has finished with. Can smooth out a session that has been running for hours.

commands.title: Master Volume
commands.description: Sets the game's master volume without leaving the console.

commands.title: Voice Chat Volume
commands.description: Sets in-game voice chat volume separately from everything else.

commands.title: Music Volume
commands.description: Turns the game's own music down or off while leaving effects alone.

commands.title: Craft On Scroll Wheel
commands.description: Queues the chosen item every time you scroll up. Popular for keeping bandages topped up mid-fight.

commands.title: List Players
commands.description: Prints everyone currently on the server with their Steam IDs.

commands.title: Server Status
commands.description: Prints the player list together with the server's current status.

commands.title: Kick Player
commands.description: Removes a player from the server. They can rejoin straight away.

commands.title: Ban Player By Name
commands.description: Bans a player by name and records the reason.

commands.title: Ban Player By Steam64
commands.description: Bans by Steam64 ID, which survives a name change.

commands.title: Unban Player
commands.description: Lifts a ban for the given Steam64 ID.

commands.title: Ban List
commands.description: Prints every active ban. The extended form adds reasons and details.

commands.title: Mute Voice
commands.description: Stops a player from using in-game voice chat.

commands.title: Unmute Voice
commands.description: Gives a player their voice chat back.

commands.title: Mute Chat
commands.description: Stops a player from sending text chat messages.

commands.title: Unmute Chat
commands.description: Gives a player their text chat back.

commands.title: Server Announcement
commands.description: Sends a message to every player through in-game chat.

commands.title: Grant Moderator
commands.description: Makes a player a server moderator.

commands.title: Remove Moderator
commands.description: Takes moderator rights away again.

commands.title: Grant Owner
commands.description: Makes a player a server owner. This is the highest level of access.

commands.title: Find Own Position
commands.description: Prints your own world position, which you need before spawning anything at a fixed spot.

commands.title: Find Entities In Radius
commands.description: Lists every entity within the given radius of you.

commands.title: Spawn Entity
commands.description: Spawns an entity where you are looking.

commands.title: Debug What I Look At
commands.description: Turns on debug output for whatever entity is under your crosshair.

commands.title: Skip Time
commands.description: Jumps the in-game clock forward by the given number of hours.

commands.title: Set Rain
commands.description: Controls rainfall. 0 is dry, 1 is permanent rain.

commands.title: Force Save
commands.description: Writes a save immediately instead of waiting for the next automatic one. Worth running before anything risky.

commands.title: Write Config
commands.description: Persists configuration changes made this session so they survive a restart.

commands.title: Read Config
commands.description: Reloads the server configuration from disk.

commands.title: Restart Server
commands.description: Restarts the server after a warning countdown shown to every player.

commands.title: Kick Everyone
commands.description: Removes every player from the server with a shared reason.

commands.title: Toggle Wide / Slim Viewmodel
commands.description: Switches the weapon model between the wide default and a slimmer one that covers less of the screen — most noticeable on the AK. Each press shows on screen which of the two you are now on.

de-DE.title: Breites / schmales Waffenmodell umschalten
de-DE.description: Schaltet das Waffenmodell zwischen der breiten Standardansicht und einer schmaleren um, die weniger vom Bildschirm verdeckt — bei der AK am deutlichsten. Jeder Druck zeigt am Bildschirm, in welchem der beiden Modi du gerade bist.

fr-FR.title: Modèle d’arme large / fin
fr-FR.description: Bascule le modèle de l’arme entre la vue large par défaut et une version plus fine qui masque moins l’écran — surtout visible sur l’AK. Chaque pression affiche à l’écran le mode actif.

es-ES.title: Alternar modelo de arma ancho / estrecho
es-ES.description: Cambia el modelo del arma entre la vista ancha por defecto y otra más estrecha que tapa menos pantalla — se nota sobre todo con el AK. Cada pulsación muestra en pantalla en cuál de los dos estás.

pt-BR.title: Alternar modelo de arma largo / estreito
pt-BR.description: Alterna o modelo da arma entre a visão larga padrão e uma mais estreita, que cobre menos da tela — mais perceptível na AK. Cada toque mostra na tela em qual dos dois você está.

ru-RU.title: Широкая / узкая модель оружия
ru-RU.description: Переключает модель оружия между широким видом по умолчанию и более узким, который меньше закрывает экран — заметнее всего на АК. Каждое нажатие показывает на экране текущий режим.

tr-TR.title: Geniş / ince silah modeli
tr-TR.description: Silah modelini varsayılan geniş görünüm ile ekranı daha az kapatan ince görünüm arasında değiştirir — en çok AK’de fark edilir. Her basışta hangi modda olduğun ekranda görünür.

pl-PL.title: Przełącz szeroki / wąski model broni
pl-PL.description: Przełącza model broni między domyślnym szerokim a węższym, który zasłania mniej ekranu — najbardziej widoczne przy AK. Każde naciśnięcie pokazuje na ekranie, w którym trybie jesteś.

zh-CN.title: 切换宽 / 窄武器模型
zh-CN.description: 在默认的宽武器模型和遮挡更少的窄模型之间切换——在 AK 上最明显。每次按键都会在屏幕上显示当前处于哪种模式。

commands.title: Volume Toggle with On-Screen Readout
commands.description: Jumps between two volume levels and prints the new one on screen, so you can tell at a glance which one you are on. Built for dropping the volume fast while recycling, flying, or eating in base — and for putting it back without guessing.

de-DE.title: Lautstärke umschalten mit Anzeige
de-DE.description: Springt zwischen zwei Lautstärken und zeigt die neue am Bildschirm an, damit du auf einen Blick weißt, wo du gerade stehst. Gedacht zum schnellen Leiserstellen beim Recyceln, Fliegen oder Essen in der Base — und zum Zurückstellen ohne Raten.

fr-FR.title: Basculer le volume avec affichage
fr-FR.description: Alterne entre deux niveaux de volume et affiche le nouveau à l’écran, pour savoir d’un coup d’œil où vous en êtes. Pensé pour baisser vite le son en recyclant, en volant ou en mangeant à la base — et le remonter sans deviner.

es-ES.title: Alternar volumen con indicador
es-ES.description: Salta entre dos niveles de volumen y muestra el nuevo en pantalla, para saber de un vistazo en cuál estás. Pensado para bajar el sonido rápido mientras reciclas, vuelas o comes en la base — y subirlo sin adivinar.

pt-BR.title: Alternar volume com indicação na tela
pt-BR.description: Alterna entre dois níveis de volume e mostra o novo na tela, para você saber num relance em qual está. Feito para baixar o som rápido enquanto recicla, voa ou come na base — e voltar sem adivinhar.

ru-RU.title: Переключение громкости с показом
ru-RU.description: Переключается между двумя уровнями громкости и показывает новый на экране, чтобы сразу видеть, где вы. Удобно быстро приглушить звук при переработке, полёте или еде на базе — и вернуть обратно без угадывания.

tr-TR.title: Ekran göstergeli ses seviyesi değiştirme
tr-TR.description: İki ses seviyesi arasında geçiş yapar ve yenisini ekranda gösterir, böylece hangisinde olduğunu bir bakışta görürsün. Geri dönüşüm yaparken, uçarken veya üste yemek yerken sesi hızla kısmak — ve tahmin etmeden geri açmak için.

pl-PL.title: Przełącz głośność z podglądem
pl-PL.description: Przeskakuje między dwoma poziomami głośności i wyświetla nowy na ekranie, więc od razu wiesz, gdzie jesteś. Do szybkiego ściszenia przy recyklingu, lataniu lub jedzeniu w bazie — i przywrócenia bez zgadywania.

zh-CN.title: 音量切换并显示当前值
zh-CN.description: 在两个音量之间切换，并在屏幕上显示新的音量，一眼就能看出当前状态。适合在回收、开小飞机或在家吃东西时快速降低音量，之后无需猜测即可调回。

commands.title: Craft and Cancel a Tool Cupboard
commands.description: Queues a Tool Cupboard, cancels it, and queues it again in a single press. Also posts a line in your own chat that reads like a server message, so you can see it fired — nobody else sees it. Set the Steam ID to your own for the name to look right.

de-DE.title: Werkzeugkiste anlegen und abbrechen
de-DE.description: Stellt eine Werkzeugkiste in die Warteschlange, bricht sie ab und stellt sie erneut hinein — alles mit einem Tastendruck. Schreibt außerdem eine Zeile in deinen eigenen Chat, die wie eine Servermeldung aussieht, damit du siehst, dass es ausgelöst hat; sonst sieht sie niemand. Trag deine eigene Steam-ID ein, damit der Name stimmt.

fr-FR.title: Lancer et annuler une armoire à outils
fr-FR.description: Met une armoire à outils en file d’attente, l’annule, puis la remet — le tout en une pression. Écrit aussi une ligne dans votre propre chat qui ressemble à un message du serveur, pour voir que ça a fonctionné ; personne d’autre ne la voit. Indiquez votre Steam ID pour que le nom soit correct.

es-ES.title: Fabricar y cancelar un armario de herramientas
es-ES.description: Pone un armario de herramientas en cola, lo cancela y lo vuelve a poner, todo con una pulsación. Además escribe una línea en tu propio chat que parece un mensaje del servidor, para que veas que se ejecutó; nadie más la ve. Pon tu Steam ID para que el nombre se vea bien.

pt-BR.title: Fabricar e cancelar um armário de ferramentas
pt-BR.description: Coloca um armário de ferramentas na fila, cancela e coloca de novo — tudo em um toque. Também escreve uma linha no seu próprio chat parecida com uma mensagem do servidor, para você ver que funcionou; mais ninguém vê. Coloque seu Steam ID para o nome aparecer certo.

ru-RU.title: Создать и отменить шкаф инструментов
ru-RU.description: Ставит шкаф инструментов в очередь, отменяет и ставит снова — одним нажатием. Также выводит в ваш собственный чат строку, похожую на сообщение сервера, чтобы вы видели, что сработало; больше её никто не видит. Укажите свой Steam ID, чтобы имя отображалось правильно.

tr-TR.title: Alet dolabı üret ve iptal et
tr-TR.description: Bir alet dolabını sıraya alır, iptal eder ve tekrar sıraya alır — hepsi tek tuşla. Ayrıca kendi sohbetine sunucu mesajı gibi görünen bir satır yazar, böylece çalıştığını görürsün; başka kimse görmez. Adın doğru görünsün diye kendi Steam ID’ni gir.

pl-PL.title: Stwórz i anuluj szafkę narzędziową
pl-PL.description: Dodaje szafkę narzędziową do kolejki, anuluje ją i dodaje ponownie — jednym naciśnięciem. Wypisuje też linię na twoim własnym czacie, wyglądającą jak wiadomość serwera, żebyś widział, że zadziałało; nikt inny jej nie widzi. Wpisz własne Steam ID, żeby nazwa wyglądała poprawnie.

zh-CN.title: 制作并取消工具柜
zh-CN.description: 一次按键即可将工具柜加入制作队列、取消，然后再次加入。同时在你自己的聊天框中写入一行看起来像服务器消息的文字，方便确认已触发——其他人看不到。填入你自己的 Steam ID，显示的名称才正确。

commands.title: Free Look with Extra Zoom
commands.description: Hold the key to look around without turning your body, with the view pulled in tighter at the same time. Combined with the normal aim zoom it gives you a second, closer step.

de-DE.title: Freie Sicht mit zusätzlichem Zoom
de-DE.description: Taste halten, um dich umzusehen, ohne dich zu drehen — gleichzeitig wird die Ansicht enger gezogen. Zusammen mit dem normalen Zielzoom ergibt das eine zweite, nähere Stufe.

fr-FR.title: Vue libre avec zoom supplémentaire
fr-FR.description: Maintenez la touche pour regarder autour de vous sans tourner le corps, avec une vue resserrée en même temps. Combiné au zoom de visée habituel, cela donne un second niveau, plus proche.

es-ES.title: Vista libre con zoom adicional
es-ES.description: Mantén la tecla para mirar alrededor sin girar el cuerpo, con la vista más cerrada al mismo tiempo. Junto con el zoom de apuntado normal te da un segundo nivel, más cercano.

pt-BR.title: Visão livre com zoom extra
pt-BR.description: Segure a tecla para olhar ao redor sem virar o corpo, com a visão mais fechada ao mesmo tempo. Junto com o zoom de mira normal, dá um segundo nível, mais próximo.

ru-RU.title: Свободный обзор с дополнительным зумом
ru-RU.description: Удерживайте клавишу, чтобы осмотреться, не поворачивая тело, — обзор при этом становится теснее. Вместе с обычным зумом прицела это даёт вторую, более близкую ступень.

tr-TR.title: Ek yakınlaştırmalı serbest bakış
tr-TR.description: Tuşu basılı tutarak vücudunu döndürmeden etrafına bak; aynı anda görüş daha da yakınlaşır. Normal nişan yakınlaştırmasıyla birlikte ikinci, daha yakın bir kademe verir.

pl-PL.title: Swobodne rozglądanie z dodatkowym zbliżeniem
pl-PL.description: Przytrzymaj klawisz, aby rozejrzeć się bez obracania postaci, przy jednoczesnym zbliżeniu widoku. Razem ze zwykłym zbliżeniem celowania daje drugi, bliższy stopień.

zh-CN.title: 自由视角加额外缩放
zh-CN.description: 按住按键即可在不转身的情况下环顾四周，同时视野被拉近。与普通瞄准缩放配合使用，可获得第二级更近的视角。

commands.title: Toggle Placement Reach
commands.description: Switches how loosely the game decides what you are pointing at. Zero makes it strict, which is what you want when upgrading building parts that sit awkwardly behind others. The new value is shown on screen.

de-DE.title: Zielgenauigkeit beim Bauen umschalten
de-DE.description: Schaltet um, wie großzügig das Spiel entscheidet, worauf du zeigst. Null macht es genau — genau das willst du, wenn du Bauteile aufwertest, die ungünstig hinter anderen liegen. Der neue Wert wird am Bildschirm angezeigt.

fr-FR.title: Basculer la précision de visée sur les constructions
fr-FR.description: Change la tolérance avec laquelle le jeu décide ce que vous visez. Zéro rend la visée stricte, ce qu’il faut pour améliorer des pièces de construction mal placées derrière d’autres. La nouvelle valeur s’affiche à l’écran.

es-ES.title: Alternar precisión de apuntado al construir
es-ES.description: Cambia lo permisivo que es el juego al decidir a qué estás apuntando. Cero lo hace estricto, que es lo que quieres al mejorar piezas de construcción mal situadas detrás de otras. El nuevo valor se muestra en pantalla.

pt-BR.title: Alternar precisão de mira ao construir
pt-BR.description: Muda o quão tolerante o jogo é ao decidir para o que você está apontando. Zero deixa preciso, que é o que você quer ao melhorar peças de construção mal posicionadas atrás de outras. O novo valor aparece na tela.

ru-RU.title: Переключение точности наведения при строительстве
ru-RU.description: Меняет то, насколько свободно игра определяет, на что вы указываете. Ноль делает наведение точным — именно это нужно при улучшении строительных элементов, неудобно расположенных за другими. Новое значение показывается на экране.

tr-TR.title: İnşada nişan hassasiyetini değiştir
tr-TR.description: Oyunun neye işaret ettiğine ne kadar geniş karar verdiğini değiştirir. Sıfır bunu kesinleştirir; başkalarının arkasında zor konumda duran yapı parçalarını yükseltirken tam da bunu istersin. Yeni değer ekranda gösterilir.

pl-PL.title: Przełącz precyzję celowania przy budowaniu
pl-PL.description: Zmienia, jak swobodnie gra decyduje, na co wskazujesz. Zero czyni celowanie precyzyjnym — dokładnie tego chcesz przy ulepszaniu elementów budowli schowanych za innymi. Nowa wartość pojawia się na ekranie.

zh-CN.title: 切换建造时的指向精度
zh-CN.description: 改变游戏判断你所指目标的宽松程度。设为 0 时更精确，正适合升级那些被其他部件挡住、位置刁钻的建筑构件。新数值会显示在屏幕上。

commands.title: Combat Log, Outgoing Damage Only
commands.description: Opens the console showing only the damage you dealt, without the incoming lines. Useful for telling a teammate how much health the player who killed you had left, without the rest of the log getting in the way.

de-DE.title: Kampfprotokoll, nur ausgeteilter Schaden
de-DE.description: Öffnet die Konsole und zeigt nur den Schaden, den du ausgeteilt hast, ohne die eingehenden Zeilen. Praktisch, um dem Team zu sagen, wie viel Leben derjenige noch hatte, der dich getötet hat — ohne dass der Rest des Protokolls dazwischenfunkt.

fr-FR.title: Journal de combat, dégâts infligés seulement
fr-FR.description: Ouvre la console en n’affichant que les dégâts que vous avez infligés, sans les lignes reçues. Pratique pour dire à un coéquipier combien de vie il restait à celui qui vous a tué, sans que le reste du journal gêne.

es-ES.title: Registro de combate, solo daño infligido
es-ES.description: Abre la consola mostrando solo el daño que has hecho, sin las líneas de daño recibido. Útil para decirle a un compañero cuánta vida le quedaba al que te mató, sin que estorbe el resto del registro.

pt-BR.title: Registro de combate, só dano causado
pt-BR.description: Abre o console mostrando apenas o dano que você causou, sem as linhas de dano recebido. Útil para dizer ao time quanta vida sobrou para quem te matou, sem o resto do registro atrapalhando.

ru-RU.title: Боевой журнал, только нанесённый урон
ru-RU.description: Открывает консоль и показывает только урон, который нанесли вы, без входящих строк. Удобно, чтобы сказать напарнику, сколько здоровья осталось у убившего вас, не отвлекаясь на остальное.

tr-TR.title: Savaş kaydı, yalnızca verilen hasar
tr-TR.description: Konsolu açar ve yalnızca senin verdiğin hasarı gösterir, gelen satırlar olmadan. Seni öldüren oyuncunun ne kadar canı kaldığını takım arkadaşına söylerken, kaydın geri kalanı yolunu tıkamaz.

pl-PL.title: Dziennik walki, tylko zadane obrażenia
pl-PL.description: Otwiera konsolę pokazującą tylko obrażenia, które zadałeś, bez linii otrzymanych. Przydatne, gdy chcesz powiedzieć koledze z drużyny, ile życia zostało temu, kto cię zabił, bez reszty dziennika w drodze.

zh-CN.title: 战斗记录，仅显示输出伤害
zh-CN.description: 打开控制台，只显示你造成的伤害，不显示受到的伤害。方便告诉队友杀死你的人还剩多少血，不会被其余记录干扰。
